title: Embody Boldly: Reality Prints What You Hold
one_liner: Authentic people can manifest anything by fully embodying their desired identity without shrinking from judgment.
key_points: Reality doesn't judge authenticity — it 'prints' whatever identity you consistently and fully hold
Inauthentic people like Erika Kirk prove embodiment works regardless of ethics, so genuine people have no excuse
The real obstacle isn't reality being too harsh — it's your nervous system's inability to tolerate visibility and criticism
Stop shrinking out of fear of being misunderstood; fully expressed identity is what attracts money, love, and status
